objective: Fresh immutable council review of exact design v39: verify closure of all 18 formally confirmed run-041 findings, exact CP registry/edge ownership, evidence path/hash bindings, council-design equality, genesis/migration/bootstrap ordering, accounting fixtures and HUMAN-facing scope. Do not build or execute WBS.
must_check: Root cause is separated from contributing conditions and symptoms and is supported by pinned evidence.
Admission prevents known unreadiness before charge without claiming impossible rollback after charge.
The design does not invent a scheduler, daemon, custom WBS runner, approval mechanism, or DSH capability.
Every control surface has one owner, exact evidence, fail state, and recovery path.
Schema validation and semantic command-to-deliverable closure are both required.
Generated AIP/ASC artifacts can only transition through declared owning commands.
Ledger migration is backup-first, lossless, deterministic, reversible, strict-validator-gated, and does not change acceptance.
Reviewer route availability, fallback and call-budget reservation distinguish provider capacity from a valid adverse verdict.
Goal, Team, coordinator, active work and execution ledger state cannot contradict at admission.
Budget policy exposes rather than hides control/recovery contingency.
HUMAN authority remains explicit for WBS approval, ceiling/reallocation, deviations, acceptance and activation.
Negative paths cover drift, sandbox loss, reviewer loss, partial commit, crash after charge, ledger conflict and zero slack.
The AdmissionBundle is proof-only, time-bounded and explicitly procedural; it neither grants execution authority nor claims non-bypassable enforcement or removal of the external-state TOCTOU race.
The design gives exact entry criteria for a later WBS build and keeps current execution frozen.

One-time strict-ledger migration and AdmissionBundle schema/validator/prepare bootstrap occur under separate HUMAN authority before WBS build, avoiding P3/P15 circularity without hiding a charged attempt.
The coordinator-owned version-guarded ledger write has explicit abort/no-write semantics and does not claim a non-bypassable native hook.
Any ambiguity that could permit charge or acceptance must be a material finding, not a note.
Every CS-01 through CS-09, CH-01 through CH-03, CA-01, and BA-01 through BA-04 finding in the pinned consistency audit is demonstrably closed in v33.
The normative composed transition table, P3 allowlist, P15 capability set, Section 9.1 lineage, failure matrix, fixtures, and WBS handoff manifest have no contradictory or missing state edge.
The candidate-template/body-commitment projection is byte-complete and acyclic, and bundle, seal, intent, completion, index, administrative ledger, and root journal hash domains are unambiguous.
RootControlJournal units and administrative/reservation/recovery units cannot double-debit, escape a ceiling, refill, recurse indefinitely, or create a recovery path rejected by its own prefix rule.
PostChargeRecoveryAllocation requires both ceilings, has closed D/B recurrence and only terminal reconciliation; it cannot restore READY, dispatch, accept, reuse, or create an attempt.
The AdmissionBundle binds the latest council-passed HUMAN-accepted design by out-of-band raw-byte hash and cannot admit against superseded v32 bytes.
Charged completion corruption has exactly one terminal outcome; manifest/index supersession is only an intermediate evidence-preserving effect.
The exact immutable 434f failure-model snapshot and v32 consistency audit are present in the packet; mutable workspace history is not substituted.
Every run-033 confirmed finding maps to an exact v34 correction; refuted findings are not reintroduced.
CP-01 through CP-16 explicitly permit FROZEN→PREPARING and READY→COMMITTING→CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_PENDING and cover every named blocked/terminal state.
Root ceiling recurrence charges U_root_j and O_root_j exactly once; no attempt-unit omission or double debit remains.
Chairman output must use the exact contracts.md shape; no rationale field, numeric confidence, top-level reviewer fields, or object-valued residual risks.
out_of_scope: Building, selecting, executing or accepting a WBS.
Modifying current mission ledgers, AIP-004, product source or accepted artifacts.
Accessing DSH beyond the separately HUMAN-authorized read-only council helper.
Network, package manager, dependency install, merge, deploy or activation.
Choosing the HUMAN budget decision on their behalf.
rubric: Check authority, Source-of-Truth precedence, requirement coverage, and internal consistency.
